incomeDefinition: The segment rows include sales to other parts of the group. Suzlon removes those sales to report group revenue from operations.
definition: The company’s result for each reported business before group finance costs, other income, unusual gains or losses and tax.
revenueTotalLabel: Gross segment revenue before removing internal sales
sourceLabel: Audited annual results filed with NSE
location: Consolidated results and note 9 segment reporting, printed results pages 1 and 4 of 7; audited year ended 31 March 2026.
notes: Removing ₹449.32 crore of internal sales leaves group revenue from operations of ₹16,679.11 crore. Reported profit after tax was ₹3,163.39 crore. The year included a ₹70 crore gain from settling a contract matter and a net deferred tax benefit of ₹749.23 crore. This tax entry is separate from cash earned on customer work.
insight: Turbines and projects brought in most of the revenue. Maintenance contributed a larger share of the business results than of gross segment revenue, so look at both activities.
